description:
The Naval Surface Warfare Center Philadelphia intends to procure (1) 20 foot storage container in accordance with Section C, Statement of Work of the attached RFQ. This procurement will be on a total small business set-aside basis. The contract will be Firm Fixed Price. 

All responses must be sent to Brooke Steele at brooke.a.steele3.civ@us.navy.mil no later than 5:30 PM EST on 27 March 2026. Please send signed copy of amended RFQ with quotation submission.

Phone calls will NOT be accepted.
